title: Executive Overview
description: Single-pane summary - every panel reuses a query already verified in another dashboard (Business Monitoring, Pipeline Health, Zone & Customer Delay Risk). No new SQL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(line_amount), 0) FROM gold.fact_sales WHERE updated_at::date = current_date
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('delivered','closed','cancelled')
SELECT round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) AS pct_on_time FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance WHERE delivery_time > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT max(extract(epoch from (now() - last_processed_ingested_at))) AS max_lag_seconds FROM control.silver_watermarks
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN silver.purchase_orders_current po ON po.purchase_order_id = f.purchase_order_id WHERE f.status = 'in-transit' AND po.target_delivery_date < now()

SELECT sum(cnt) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM silver.error_customers WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_products WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_purchase_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_product_on_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_invoices WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_inventory_changes WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_fleet WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_positions WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') t
